visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young male creator stands indoors against a wooden wall with shelves, holding multiple colorful packages of 'Astronaut Ice Cream'. He looks into the camera with an exaggerated, excited expression. (2) He holds up a specific silver package labeled 'Cookies & Cream Ice Cream Sandwich', centering it for the camera. (3) A brief archival clip shows a female astronaut in a space station environment attempting to consume a liquid from a pouch. (4) The creator opens the silver package and reveals a rectangular, dark brown ice cream sandwich. He holds it with a white napkin. (5) He attempts to bite into the sandwich, showing visible dental strain and shaking his head to emphasize its extreme hardness. (6) He switches to a green-filled ice cream sandwich (Mint Chocolate) and repeats the exaggerated biting motion. (7) He reveals a Neapolitan version with three layers of color (pink, white, brown) and bites into it. (8) The creator talks directly to the camera, gesturing with his hands while seated on a white sofa with patterned pillows. (9) A split-screen or overlay appears showing high-quality 3D video game footage featuring futuristic landscapes and combat. (10) He finishes by giving a thumbs-up to the camera with the game's logo overlaid on the screen.
visual_base.text_narrative_log: (1) [Subtitle]: 我們來吃一些. (2) [Subtitle]: 只有太空人才能吃到的食物. (3) [Subtitle]: 以前科幻電影不是常演說. (4) [Subtitle]: 地球未來的資源會被人類消耗光. (5) [Subtitle]: 到時候我們都會住到太空上. (6) [Subtitle]: 所以我們今天就是要來提前適應地球終末的那一天. (7) [Subtitle]: 因為太空是無重力的環境. (8) [Subtitle]: 所以這些東西據說吃起來跟我們想像的東西會很不一樣. (9) [Subtitle]: OK首先來吃這個冰淇淋三明治. (10) [Subtitle]: 欸好酷喔，巧克力夾心餅乾. (11) [Subtitle]: 這鬼東西硬到可以當磚頭敲了，太硬了吧！. (12) [Subtitle]: 很好吃欸，它就是一個正常的巧克力夾心餅乾. (13) [Subtitle]: 但是為什麼吃了沒有讓我飛到太空上的感覺. (14) [Subtitle]: 這是薄荷巧克力. (15) [Subtitle]: OK它外面都是一樣的威化餅，它只是內餡不一樣，而這個呢是薄荷巧克力，這什麼奇怪的顏色. (16) [Subtitle]: 這也太硬了吧. (17) [Subtitle]: 彌補了太空中沒有黑人牙膏的遺憾，吃起來像一大塊的牙膏. (18) [Subtitle]: 最後也是最特別的一個東西，這個叫那不勒斯三色冰淇淋. (19) [Subtitle]: 真的就是字面上的意思，那不勒斯三色冰淇淋. (20) [Subtitle]: 為什麼也這麼硬啊. (21) [Subtitle]: 草莓冰淇淋欸，真的是草莓冰淇淋的感覺. (22) [Subtitle]: 這吃起來有早餐店的草莓調味乳的味道. (23) [Subtitle]: 吃完後的感想是，還蠻好吃的欸，雖然感覺他們已經硬到在跟我牙齒比硬度了，但我會努力適應的. (24) [Subtitle]: 會突然想吃這個是因為我最近都在關注明日方舟：終末地這款遊戲. (25) [Logo]: 明日方舟：終末地 ARKNIGHTS ENDFIELD. (26) [Subtitle]: 一個故事發生在塔衛二星球上的3D即時策略RPG. (27) [Subtitle]: 可以探索整個星球建立自己的工業帝國. (28) [Subtitle]: 每次看主角在帝江號上欣賞太空風景，我就想說，他們的食物到底吃起來是什麼味道啊，現在我知道了. (29) [Subtitle]: 好日子你們都自己藏著過是吧？. (30) [Subtitle]: 而且明日方舟中還有超多有趣的玩法，想知道就直接玩. (31) [Subtitle]: 現在馬上預約明日方舟：終末地，一起來塔衛二展開冒險吧！

visual_human_presence.countingEvidence: 1 main male creator throughout; 1 female astronaut in a short archival clip insertion.
visual_human_presence.mainCharacterDescription: A young male with black hair, wearing a neutral-colored grey t-shirt, exhibiting high facial energy and expressive gestures.

visual_scene_and_style.backgroundDescribe: A modern home interior with a wooden paneled wall, floating wooden shelves, and a white sofa featuring yellow and white patterned pillows resembling luxury brand designs. Later, digital game backgrounds with futuristic tech and alien landscapes appear.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) Fast-paced, enthusiastic male narration begins. The tone is highly energetic and comedic. A cheerful, synth-heavy background music track plays. Sharp rustling of plastic food packaging is heard as the creator handles multiple bags. (2) A loud, exaggerated 'crunch' sound effect occurs as the creator attempts to bite the ice cream sandwich, accompanied by a strained vocal grunt. (3) The BGM continues as he describes the flavor, with periodic 'whoosh' transitions and cartoonish 'ding' sound effects for emphasis. (4) The audio cuts to a more grand, cinematic orchestral theme as the creator pivots to discussing the video game 'Arknights: Endfield'. His speech remains clear and rapid, maintaining a high level of persuasive energy. (5) The video ends with a celebratory sound effect and a final enthusiastic call to action in the narration.

narrative_and_purpose.narrativeStructure: Montage: Hook -> Experience -> Transition -> Endorsement -> CTA
narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video starts as a comedic taste-test review of various 'Astronaut Ice Cream' products to hook the audience with humor regarding their unexpected hardness. This serves as a thematic bridge to promote the sci-fi mobile game 'Arknights: Endfield,' linking the concept of space food to the game's futuristic setting and encouraging pre-registrations.

endorsement_analysis.endorsementCues: Direct spoken promotion of the game title, gameplay footage display, and a concluding call to pre-register.

high_inference.freeDescribe: Professional social-media editing style with heavy use of variety-show subtitles and sound effects. The narrative transition from a snack review to a game ad is seamless and targeted at a youth demographic.
